ui.chat.analytics.filters.top_level_only.role: checkbox label filtering the by-session table to top-level sessions
ui.chat.analytics.filters.top_level_only.tone: label phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.filters.top_level_only.note: Sits beside the session search field in the analytics panel. It hides subagent rows rather than sorting them, so the word 'only' is load-bearing.

ui.chat.analytics.search.clear.role: accessible name of the button that empties the session search field
ui.chat.analytics.search.clear.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.search.clear.note: Screen-reader only: the button shows an icon. It clears the query and returns focus to the field beside it.

ui.chat.analytics.search.sessions.role: shared accessible name and placeholder of the by-session search field
ui.chat.analytics.search.sessions.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.search.sessions.note: One message used twice on the same input: as its aria-label and as its placeholder. It names what searching narrows — the session rows of this window — not the whole app.

ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_channel.role: heading of the by-channel spend table
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_channel.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_channel.note: Heads the section that breaks published spend down per channel. It renders only on a backend that advertises the channel ledger.

ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_model.role: heading of the by-model usage table
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_model.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_model.note: Heads the table that ranks models by output tokens for the selected window. The meta beside it says it comes from the ledger and is ranked by output tokens.

ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_provider.role: heading of the by-provider usage table
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_provider.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_provider.note: Heads the table that groups ledger calls per provider. It is one of three table headings that share the 'By …' shape, so keep the preposition consistent.

ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_session.role: heading of the by-session usage table
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_session.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.sections.by_session.note: Heads the sortable table of own figures per session. The meta beside it notes that totals include subagents, which is why the top-level filter sits above the table.

ui.chat.analytics.sections.totals.role: heading of the analytics panel's aggregate stat cards
ui.chat.analytics.sections.totals.tone: noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.sections.totals.note: Heads the requests, tokens and cost cards above the charts. The meta beside it names the window and scope those totals cover.

ui.chat.analytics.title.role: dialog title of the analytics panel
ui.chat.analytics.title.tone: noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.title.note: Heads the read-only analytics panel opened from the picker. The description beneath it names the backend ledger as the source.

ui.chat.analytics.toolbar.refreshing.role: status text beside the analytics toolbar controls while a refetch is in flight
ui.chat.analytics.toolbar.refreshing.tone: plain status, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.toolbar.refreshing.note: Pushed to the toolbar's far edge while the next read is in flight; it states that the numbers below may move rather than blocking the panel.

ui.chat.analytics.toolbar.this_session_o.role: checkbox label scoping the analytics panel to the open session
ui.chat.analytics.toolbar.this_session_o.tone: label phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.analytics.toolbar.this_session_o.note: Renders in the toolbar only when the panel may scope to a session. It narrows every section of the panel, and the window meta names the resulting scope.
